name: By Proxy
source:
Awoken by a mysterious alarm, you take the role of an Unnamed protagonist. 

Your friend’s urgent message draws you into the ship’s depths, where creatures stir in the shadows. They are not here to help you. Survival becomes your first task.

[From [url=https://olivebug.itch.io/by-proxy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被神秘的警报惊醒，扮演一位无名的主角。

你朋友的紧急消息将你带入船的深处，那里的生物在阴影中骚动。他们不是来帮助你的。生存成为你的首要任务。

[来自[url=https://olivebug.itch.io/by-proxy]Itch.io[/url]]
